_comment: Closed vocabularies for ENUM-tier facts fields (ADR-1202). Extended only by reviewed diff. An unknown value is a parse error, never a passthrough.

labels._comment: Human-readable phrasing for each enum value. The renderer NEVER prints a raw enum token into a sentence; it prints the label. A value with no label is a render error, so adding a vocabulary entry forces someone to write its words. KEYED BY FIELD PATH (`operator.type`), not by vocabulary name (`operator_type`) -- the template asks for `label.<field path>`, and two keying schemes in one file is how a lookup silently returns nothing.

data_categories.identity: your name and the identity details you give us
data_categories.contact: your email address, phone number and postal address
data_categories.account-credentials: your login credentials and authentication records
data_categories.billing: your billing details and payment records
data_categories.usage-analytics: how you use the service, in aggregate

purposes.authenticate-and-secure: to sign you in and keep the account secure
